The `QueryableCreator` is a function type defined in `thanos/pkg/query/querier.go` (lines 56-71). It creates `storage.Queryable` instances with parameters for deduplication, replica labels, store matchers, max resolution, etc. It is used extensively in Thanos's HTTP (v1.go) and gRPC (grpc.go) query APIs.
